data.title: Finland vs Belarus prediction, preview & betting tips – 29/09/2026
data.content:
Friis is expected to select the same XI that started the win over San Marino, with no fresh injuries or suspensions. Their two biggest absentees are Naatan Skytta and Niklas Pyyhtia.

As for Belarus, their Nations League campaign began with a disappointing but expected 2-0 defeat at the hands of Albania.

Given that Albania are the favourites to win Group C1, the result won't have stung too hard, but they must now respond against Finland, a nation they haven't faced in eight years. [...] Belarus have never qualified for a major international tournament before, and realistically, a strong performance in this group provides them with a likelier route to a Euro 2028 playoff than the main qualifying group will.

Manager Viktor Goncharenko has been in charge since the beginning of the year and has enjoyed a solid tenure thus far, with a W3, D1, L1 record. On Tuesday, he has no fresh injury concerns and may go in unchanged.
